nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed/cleared by acceptOwnership.
Mapping of token holder balances, credited/debited by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance written by approve and approveAndCall, read by transferFrom and allowance.
Total token supply (_totalSupply = 200000000 * 10^18) assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
AmasaToken constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing a pending new owner; protected by msg.sender == owner check.
Completes ownership handover when msg.sender == newOwner; emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
ERC20 transfer: debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend check.
ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to', reducing 'from' balance and msg.sender allowance.
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract for the owner.
SafeMath subtraction with require(b <= a) guard, returns a - b.
SafeMath addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard, returns a + b.
SafeMath multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath division with require(b > 0) guard, returns a / b.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for a given address.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-chosen contract after allowance state is written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied, unverified contract address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() outside SafeMath.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(): recipient of the tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(): amount to move.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(): address granted the allowance.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(): allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(): account debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(): account credited.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(): amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(): also the external contract called back.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(): allowance and amount forwarded to the callback.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(): arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(): arbitrary external contract targeted by the call.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token(): amount passed to the external transfer call.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership(): pending owner address.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd(): first operand.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd(): second operand.
Local 'c' of safeAdd(): holds a + b and is checked for overflow.
